query:
UPDATE commands
               SET token = $2, createat = $3, updateat = $4, creatorid = $5, teamid = $6,
                   method = $7, username = $8, iconurl = $9, autocomplete = $10,
                   autocompletedesc = $11, autocompletehint = $12, displayname = $13,
                   description = $14, url = $15, pluginid = $16, "trigger" = $17
             WHERE id = $1
